arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} | shape={df.shape} ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=20))

import sys
import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)


def is_total_row(row):
    return any(isinstance(v, str) and "total" in v.lower() for v in row)


grand_total = 0.0
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    data = df.iloc[1:]  # exclude header row
    data = data[~data.apply(is_total_row, axis=1)]  # exclude total rows
    col_sums = {}
    for col in data.columns:
        s = pd.to_numeric(data[col], errors="coerce").sum()
        if s:
            col_sums[str(col)] = round(float(s), 2)
    sheet_total = sum(col_sums.values())
    grand_total += sheet_total
    print(f"Column sums (excl. header/total rows): {col_sums}")
    print(f"Sheet total: {sheet_total:.2f}\n")

print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES ACROSS ALL CATEGORIES: {grand_total:.2f}")
